add_params: add CLI arguments for COLLAB hyperparameters including learning rate, optimizer, GNN layers, and embedding size to an argparse parser
run_COLLAB_training: run a COLLAB graph classification experiment with euclidean manifold embeddings using the default hyperparameter configuration
configure_optimizer: configure the optimizer type (sgd, adam, or amsgrad) and learning rate scheduler for COLLAB training
set_gnn_architecture: set the GNN architecture parameters including number of layers, embedding size, dropout, and activation function
configure_data_paths: configure the train, validation, and test file paths for COLLAB dataset with fold-based cross-validation
